general.description: Manage the external apps that call the generic payment gateway and the channels they may use.

list.sublineEmpty: Create a payment app, hand out its secret and external apps can start payments.
list.deleteModalMessage: Delete "{app}"? Its payment orders are kept, but its secret stops working right away.

detail.notFound: This payment app cannot be found, it may have been deleted.
detail.platformAccountNotice: The platform payment app: the platform collects through this account itself. The name, the callbacks and the channels can be changed; the identifier is written by the installation and cannot be changed, and the app cannot be deleted. The merchant account is maintained on the payment providers page.
detail.platformCredentialHint: The merchant account of the platform is maintained on the payment providers page. It is only shown here, and changing it affects what the platform itself collects:
detail.cardApplicationSubtitle: The technical name authenticates the app, change it with care.
detail.labelTechnicalNameHelpText: The app_id the external app sends with every request.
detail.labelActiveHelpText: An inactive app cannot start payments anymore.
detail.cardSecuritySubtitle: Where the payment results are reported, the secret that signs the requests, and who may call the payment api.
detail.labelRateLimitHelpText: Requests per minute, empty means unlimited.
detail.labelAppSecretHelpText: Left empty, the stored secret stays unchanged.
detail.placeholderAllowedIps: One IP per line, empty means every IP
detail.labelAllowedIpsHelpText: Only the listed IPs may call the payment api.
detail.secretHint: The secret is shown once, copy it now and keep it safe, it cannot be read again.
detail.cardAccountSubtitle: Whose merchant account collects the money of each interface. An app either uses its own account or the account of another app.
detail.labelAccountSourceHelpText: An own account needs the merchant account details of this app. Another app reuses its account, and the details are maintained there.
detail.accountSourceOwn: Use the account of this app
detail.accountSourceInheritance: {provider} collects through the merchant account of "{app}", its credentials and channel parameters are maintained there.
detail.accountSourceWarning: "{app}" is not authorized for {provider}, so its account cannot be reused. Authorize {provider} there first, otherwise a payment through this interface is refused.
detail.cardChannelSubtitle: The product forms of each interface. The channels enabled here are the ones the users of this app can pick.
detail.providerNotAuthorizedHint: Not authorized, its channels cannot be enabled.
detail.channelParamsInherited: The channel parameters belong to the merchant account of "{app}" and are maintained there.
detail.secretModalMessage: Copy and store the secret now, it cannot be read again.
detail.deleteModalMessage: Delete "{app}"? Its payment orders are kept, but its secret stops working right away.

notification.saveSuccess: The payment app has been saved.
notification.deleteSuccess: The payment app has been deleted.
